objective: Establish chronology-clean economic baselines for fast 1Min and slow 1H MNQ research before model-family tuning or orchestration selection.
nq_boundary: NQ is not an input to these MNQ models. NQ remains reserved for later external validation and pre-MNQ historical extension after an MNQ hypothesis earns advancement.
features: Same causal feature family at each resolution: lagged log returns, realized volatility, range/body, volume z-scores, EMA distance, momentum, time-of-day and day-of-week. No forward-aligned features.
chronology: Quarterly expanding walk-forward. Training ends at least one forecast horizon before each evaluation quarter. No random split. No OOS hyperparameter, threshold, feature, phase, week, year, or regime selection.
target: Three-class volatility-scaled future move: long if forward log move exceeds +vol_multiplier * rolling volatility * sqrt(horizon), short below the negative threshold, otherwise abstain/neutral.

economic_contract.phase_rule: Every absolute-UTC non-overlap phase modulo forecast horizon is reported. None may be selected after outcomes are visible.
economic_contract.weekly_reporting: Every complete-enough futures trade week is reported. Partial weeks may be excluded only by the same deterministic support rule for all periods.
required_metrics: OOS balanced accuracy and macro F1
weekly median of non-overlap phase net points

interpretation_rule: This pass is discovery/foundation, not promotion. A configuration earns a model-family or orchestration challenge only if economics are nontrivial after 1-point cost, not obviously concentrated in one period, and supported by enough chronological weeks. Weak or negative baselines eliminate that target/resolution before tuning.
